answer: Neighborhood overlap quorum. An agent's actions are valid only if endorsed by peers whose interaction graphs overlap above a threshold, sampled like a branching river of trust paths. Forging many identities requires each to sustain a distinct, non-overlapping voyage through genuine counterparties, since shared neighbors get discounted. An attacker pays the cost of building and maintaining separate real interaction histories per identity, scaling linearly with the sybil count and never amortizing across the willow of shared contacts.
